# Backend Academy
> A modern, AI-powered learning platform for backend development.

## About
Backend Academy teaches backend development through structured, project-based learning. It features an integrated AI Tutor powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Gemini and Groq LLMs.

## Tech Stack
- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 4.1.0, Spring Security, Spring AI, Flyway, PostgreSQL (Supabase), PgVector
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Zustand, React Router, Vanilla CSS
- AI: Gemini (Primary), Groq (Fallback), ONNX local embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

## Pages
- [Home](https://backend-academy-one.vercel.app/): Landing page with featured courses
- [Login](https://backend-academy-one.vercel.app/auth/login): Student and instructor authentication
- [Register](https://backend-academy-one.vercel.app/auth/register): Create a new account
- [Courses](https://backend-academy-one.vercel.app/courses): Browse all published courses
- [Dashboard](https://backend-academy-one.vercel.app/dashboard): Student progress dashboard (authenticated)

## API
- Base URL: https://backend-academy-tpzc.onrender.com
- Documentation: /swagger-ui.html
- Authentication: JWT Bearer tokens
